- [AI Agent Course: Free Online Training](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-agent-course/): Explore AI agent courses designed to enhance your skills in artificial intelligence and machine learning. Start learning with free online training today.
- [What Is Agentic Architecture?](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/agentic-architecture/): Explore the capabilities and benefits of agentic RAG, a next-generation AI model that enhances content generation with autonomous, adaptable AI agents.
- [AgentExchange - AI Agent Marketplace](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/agentexchange/): AgentExchange is a marketplace designed to empower businesses to harness the power of agentic AI. Try it today!
- [Trailblazer Sign Up: Unlock the Best Trailblazer Benefits for Free](https://www.salesforce.com/account-benefits/): With the benefits of a Trailblazer account, the world of Salesforce is at your fingertips. Sign up to access free online learning, events, support, and more!
- [AI Agent Builder: Agentforce](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/agent-builder/): Create custom AI agents effortlessly with Agentforce's AI Agent Builder. Empower your business with pre set templates or build with no code.
- [How to Build an AI Agent](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/agent-builder/how-to-build/): Discover the essential steps, from data collection to deployment, and build a powerful AI-driven agent tailored to your needs.
- [Salesforce: The #1 AI CRM](https://www.salesforce.com/): Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together with AI, data, and Customer 360 apps on one unified platform.
- [Accelerate Agentic AI Development](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/accelerate-agentic-ai/): Develop and deploy AI agents 16x faster with Agentforce. Enhance accuracy by 75% and reduce complexity. Download the Valoir report to learn how Agentforce accelerates your AI journey.
- [Agentforce for Employees](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/agentforce-for-employees/): Agentforce is transforming employee productivity with multi-turn, multi-channel agent conversations across Salesforce Lightning, Mobile, and Slack.
- [Agentforce: The AI Agent Platform](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/): Build and customize autonomous AI agents to support your employees and customers 24/7, including full integration with the Salesforce ecosystem.
- [AI Agent vs. Chatbot - What's the Difference?](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-agent-vs-chatbot/): Confused about the difference between an AI agent and a chatbot? This primer goes into the basics and should help clear things up.
- [What Are Agentic Workflows?](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/agentic-workflows/): Agentic workflows are structured processes where autonomous AI agents make decisions, solve problems, and perform tasks with minimal human input.
- [What Is Agentic RAG?](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/agentic-rag/): Explore the capabilities and benefits of agentic RAG, a next-generation AI model that enhances content generation with autonomous, adaptable AI agents.
- [What Is the Agentic Enterprise? (2025)](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/agentic-enterprise/): Explore the core tenets of the agentic enterprise, a model where human employees and AI agents collaborate to enhance productivity, creativity, and customer loyalty.
- [Agentic Enterprise Index](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/agentic-enterprise-index/): The Agentic Enterprise represents a fundamental shift in the way the world does business by leveraging AI agents. Learn How.
- [Agentforce ROI Calculator](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-agents-roi-calculator/): Discover the value of Agentforce with our ROI Calculator. See how the Service Agent can enhance productivity, improve customer satisfaction, and boost business performance.
- [AI Agents: Definition, Types, Examples](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-agents/): AI agents help your teams get more done and connect with customers around the clock. Here's a look at what they are and how they work.
- [What Are Autonomous Agents?](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-agents/autonomous-agents/): Autonomous agents are a form of AI that understand and respond to inquiries without human intervention. Here's how they can help companies.
- [AI Agent Frameworks: A Practical Guide (2025)](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-agents/ai-agent-frameworks/): Explore the key factors and benefits of AI agent frameworks to select the right one for your business and drive innovation and growth.
- [Agentforce ROI Report](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-agents-roi-report/): Discover the value of Agentforce with our ROI Report. See how the Service Agent can enhance productivity, improve customer satisfaction, and boost business performance.
- [What Are Multi-Agent Systems?](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-agents/multi-agent-systems/): Multi-agent systems are AI-driven networks of autonomous agents that interact to solve problems, optimize decisions, and coordinate tasks efficiently.
- [What Are Intelligent Agents? A Guide (2025)](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-agents/intelligent-agents/): An intelligent agent is an autonomous AI application that proactively supports employees and customers, executing tasks with trusted data.
- [Agentforce and RAG: Best Practices for Better Agents](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/agentforce-and-rag/): This guide explores how Agentforce  and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) work together, with practical tips to enhance agent performance.
- [What is an AI Copilot](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-copilot/): AI copilots are popping up in digital experiences everywhere. Learn how they differ from traditional chatbots and why they are important.
- [Maximize AI business impact](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-business-impact/): Discover how to use AI to deliver real ROI, reduce risk, and lead transformation with confidence.
- [Best AI Agent Platforms (2025)](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-agents/platform/): Learn how AI agent platforms are revolutionizing businesses through task automation, productivity enhancement, and smarter decision-making.
- [What is an AI Assistant?](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-assistant/): Learn what AI assistants are and how they can improve personalization, decision-making, efficiency, and enhance industry-specific tasks.
- [What Is a Chatbot?](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/chatbot/): A chatbot is a computer program that digitally engages with customers either by voice or text communication to help find a resolution or solve an issue.
- [AI Agents For Business and Application Development](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-software-development/): Agents are set to transform AI software development and how businesses operate and interact with customers. Here's how they work.
- [Accelerate AI Readiness with a Strong Foundation](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-readiness/): True AI readiness starts with more than tools. Learn how to align your organization for scalable value and confidently lead your next wave of AI transformation
- [Chatbot vs. Conversational AI: What Makes Them Different](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/chatbot-vs-conversational-ai/): Learn the key differences between chatbot vs. conversational AI and how to pick the right one for your business.
- [The Top Chatbot Best Practices for Service](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/chatbot/best-practices/): Discover the top chatbot best practices to enhance service experience and boost customer satisfaction.
- [Build an AI-Ready Workforce Today](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-ready-workforce/): Discover how to build an AI-ready workforce and evolve your workplace for the future.
- [Agentforce Command Center](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/command-center/): Analyze and optimize Agentforce from a single, unified tool with Command Center. It's your all-in-one agentic app for providing clear insights and recommendations to get the most from Agentforce.
- [Dining Alfiasco Commercial](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/commercials/dining-alfiasco/): Learn what Agentforce is and how it enhances sales and customer service with AI and automation in our video. Watch now to see the benefits!
- [How to Pick the Best AI Chatbot](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/chatbot/best/): With the best AI chatbot, you can transform customer service. Follow these 3 easy steps to choose the best AI chatbot for your business.
- [Gate Expectations Commercial](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/commercials/gate-expectations/): Learn what Agentforce is and how it enhances sales and customer service with AI and automation in our video. Watch now to see the benefits!
- [Agentforce for Developers](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/dev-tools/): AgentforceDX empowers developers to build, test, and optimize AI agents faster. Enjoy low-code ease, pro-code power, and real-time analytics. Explore with our free Developer Edition.
- [Watch the Agentforce TV Commercials](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/commercials/): Watch the new Salesforce TV commercials to see how Agentforce is changing the business world with Agentic AI.
- [What Is an AI Chatbot?](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/chatbot/what-is-an-ai-chatbot/): An AI chatbot is an autonomous digital assistant that uses artificial intelligence to understand and respond to inquiries in real time.
- [Agentforce Customer Stories](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/customer-stories/): Discover real-life success stories from Agentforce users. See how our platform has transformed their businesses and improved their productivity.
- [Chatbot vs. Conversational AI: What Makes Them Different](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/chatbot/chatbot-vs-conversational-ai/): Learn the key differences between chatbot vs. conversational AI and how to pick the right one for your business.
- [Optimize Your Consumption](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/digital-wallet/): With Digital Wallet, organizations can get near real-time consumption insights and usage trends for consumption based Salesforce products like Data Cloud and Agentforce.

How Data 360 activates trusted data everywhere

Informatica

Informatica from Salesforce delivers agentic and headless data management, governed metadata, and AI-ready pipelines across any cloud. Powered by Claire AI, it turns trusted, connected data into ready-to-use intelligence anywhere.
Learn more

Data 360

Teach your AI how your business actually works. Data 360 takes your structured records and unstructured files and enriches them into structured context. This eliminates AI hallucinations, reduces model processing costs, and ensures AI agents execute tasks using your actual business rules.
Learn more

Tableau Semantics

Tableau Semantics is the AI-powered semantic layer built into Data 360 and Tableau Next, letting you define data models once with AI-assisted modeling, then activate trusted, governed insights everywhere via any agent or app.
Learn more

Salesforce Guardian

Salesforce Guardian is Salesforce's suite of data security, privacy, and resilience add-on products that protect your org — simplifying compliance, strengthening security posture, enabling proactive threat detection, and governing structured and unstructured data.
Learn more

MuleSoft

MuleSoft's Anypoint Platform lets you build reusable APIs to connect any system, app, or device — unlocking data, automating workflows, and now governing AI agents at scale via Agent Fabric, all with built-in security.
Learn more

Agent Fabric

MuleSoft Agent Fabric is an enterprise agent control plane that discovers, orchestrates, governs, and observes any AI agent regardless of where it's built — turning scattered, unmanaged agents into a secure, coordinated network built on MuleSoft.
